claims.claim: The item is a solar panel (brand: NETWORK SOLAR VENTURES).
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a large rectangular photovoltaic panel with a white frame; branding text is faintly visible on the back/underside.

claims.claim: The seller deals in solar products (general business claim).
claims.evidence: Seller message is generic and does not describe this specific panel’s specs or condition.

risks.risk: Wattage/rating is unknown; price depends heavily on whether it’s low-power (e.g., ~100W) or higher-power (e.g., ~200W+).
risks.proof: A clear photo/screenshot of the panel rating label (Wattage/Model/Serial) on the back/side, or a close-up showing the exact printed specifications.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a lower-wattage, basic used panel (worst-case for value) until the rating label is readable.

risks.risk: Cell type/efficiency (mono vs poly) and overall performance are unknown.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the cell grid/type markings (or the spec label) showing mono/poly and efficiency.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard/less efficient cells until confirmed.

risks.risk: Physical damage may exist but isn’t clearly visible (micro-cracks, delamination, water ingress, scratches beyond glare).
risks.proof: Photos taken in non-glare lighting plus a close-up of the glass edges and corners; ideally a clip showing the panel surface under angled light to reveal cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/used with reduced output until condition is clearly shown.

risks.risk: Frame condition (dents, rust/corrosion, loose mounting holes) is not shown.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the frame corners and mounting holes showing any dents/rust/corrosion.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing minor repair/with uncertain mounting integrity.

risks.risk: Junction box condition and bypass diodes status are unknown (can affect safety and output).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the junction box area (front/back) and any visible wiring/diode markings; also a short clip showing the junction box cover and connections.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown electrical condition (worst-case) until junction box is confirmed.

risks.risk: Connector type and cable condition (MC4 vs other, cable length, wear) are unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the connectors and cable ends, showing connector type and any damage; include cable length measurement or a tape-measure shot.
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring connector/cable replacement if not confirmed.

risks.risk: Only the panel is shown; missing accessories (mounting hardware, charge controller, inverter, battery) could affect total usability.
risks.proof: A photo list/clip showing what is included in the package (mounting rails, junction box accessories, cables, hardware).
risks.if_unproven: Price as panel-only (no accessories) since only the panel is evidenced.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the back rating label showing exact wattage (W), model number, and serial/ID.
Send a photo showing cell type (mono/poly) and efficiency from the label/spec sheet (if available).
Send angled-light photos of the glass surface, especially corners and edges, to check for micro-cracks/delamination (reduce glare).
Send close-ups of the frame corners and mounting holes to confirm no dents/rust/corrosion.
Send a clear photo of the junction box area and connectors (connector type and cable condition).
Confirm what is included with the panel (mounting hardware, cables, junction box accessories) versus panel-only.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a solar panel and provides brand visibility, so it can be priced at a worst-case used-panel value; key specs (wattage/condition) are not readable, so the price should assume the lowest likely value until labels and condition are proven.
